主要内容: The Walt Disney Company extended the expiration date of the Exchange Offers and Consent Solicitations for 21CFA Notes from January 28, 2019, to February 1, 2019. The Exchange Offers involve exchanging 21CFA Notes for new notes issued by TWDC Holdco 613 Corp. and cash. The extension is part of the Acquisition of 21CF, which is a condition for the settlement of the Exchange Offers and Consent Solicitations. The process is subject to the terms and conditions outlined in the offering memorandum and consent solicitation statement dated October 5, 2018, with amendments and updates provided in subsequent press releases. The settlement is expected to occur promptly upon the closing of the Acquisition. The Company anticipates that the closing of the Acquisition will occur in the first half of 2019, potentially extending the Expiration Date. If the conditions for the Exchange Offers and Consent Solicitations are satisfied or waived, settlement will occur upon the consummation of the Acquisition. If the Acquisition is not completed, the 21CFA Notes will be returned to the tendering holders. The Company plans to provide notice of any extensions to the Expiration Date.
